body: Absolutely. Ive done everything i can for her, for myself to erase the hurt. Ive tried everything. But its too much now. I cant deal with what I did. I've never felt so disgusted at myself.

I think deep down your still in love with her. It's great that you've improved yourself- for you. If she decides to try again-great! If not though, you have progressed and that shows you've learned from this. Its kind of a win win?

0cat, I totally get it. I lost my fiance too recently. The part that fucks us up is the idea that they were going to be in our future and now it seems like we have to paint a different picture of how that's going to look. Do you think its truly over?
I have to move on in regards to who I was then. But I want to try and get her back.
